evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: oversized round ball body, chunky flanges and a broad wheel; all parts centred (alignment 0.0) and seated (no gaps, small intentional penetrations).

evidence.V6: Disciplined: one hue (teal) in two values for body/pipes, gold accent on flanges/collars/wheel, ink-dark bolts, steel-grey stem; strong value contrast.

evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold accent + ink dark + steel grey + one hue, chamfered edges and smooth shading; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the hue as expected.
